name: Four-Archetype Melee
description: Metropolis. One city, four rivals, four playbooks. Simple undercuts on price, Adaptive reads the room and counters, VerticalIntegrator squeezes COGS with a farm-to-shelf chain, and TechLeader bets the farm on Q+T+B at a 30% premium. You have to top the brand chart in soft drink AND car, grind out 18 consecutive profitable months, and still be worth $40M when the dust settles — over seven years.

goals.description: Top the soft drink brand chart in Metropolis (70 awareness) — the volume aisle everyone fights over.
Top the car brand chart in Metropolis (70 awareness) — TechLeader's hero turf; take it from them.
Post 18 consecutive months of positive net income — melee survivors have to be earners, not just spenders.
Grow corporate value to $40M — with four rivals pounding the same city, a positive balance sheet is a verdict.
Outlast the melee for 84 months — a seven-year grind is the point.
